# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| 1.0.x | Yes |
| Earlier versions | No |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues or discussions.

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/lfeternity/nono/security/advisories/new) and include:

- the affected version and component;
- clear reproduction steps or a proof of concept;
- the expected and actual security impact;
- any suggested mitigation, if available.

Reports concerning credential handling, desktop-control boundaries, command execution, installer behavior, or sensitive-data exposure are especially important. Remove unrelated personal data, credentials, and API keys from screenshots and logs before submitting them.

The maintainer will aim to acknowledge a report within 7 days and provide a status update within 14 days. Please allow time for investigation and remediation before public disclosure.

## 安全漏洞报告

请勿通过公开 Issue 或 Discussion 披露安全漏洞。请使用 [GitHub 私密漏洞报告](https://github.com/lfeternity/nono/security/advisories/new)，并提供受影响版本、复现步骤、实际影响和可行的缓解建议。

提交截图或日志前，请移除无关的个人信息、凭据和 API 密钥。维护者计划在 7 天内确认收到报告，并在 14 天内提供处理进度。
